reviews.x: I have long thick hair and was so glad I found these! I had some of the originals from probably 15+ years ago that was pretty ragged looking and I have bought several different replacements over the years but all I could find is the microfiber ones that just don't absorb good! These are long, soft and absorb great! No more water trickling down my neck or fighting to get all my hair inside of them! Love, Love, Love them and worth every penny!!

I love that these are the original and not the microfiber.  The microfiber are terrible.  I love these. I have been looking for them for a very long time. They came exactly as described and in a timely manner.  Very satisfied.

reviews.t: Only the cotton Turbie Twists for me
reviews.x: I cannot handle the scratchy feel of the microfiber Turbie Twists, so finding a pack of 4 cotton ones for a good price was the best part of my day.
This is so much better than a towel! I wrap my hair right out of a shower. In a few in a few minutes it’s ready to blow dry. The blow dry is quicker than I ever got after a towel dry.

reviews.t: Not as good quality as original product
reviews.x: They were cut smaller than ones I have purchased in the past

reviews.t: The ORIGINAL Turbie Twist Towel. Don't be fooled by generic imitations.
reviews.x: Mine arrived neatly packaged in 4 little sheer draw string bags so you could give these away separately as gifts if you wanted too. These are the original Turbie Twist Towels as another user kindly stated helping me decide to make this purchase. These are the thick cotton ones with the loop. They are expensive but these are worth every penny for the originals that will last you for years to come.

I had never tried Turbie Towels before and I was skeptical that they would work on my thick hair, but I was very pleasantly surprised! The cotton has held up excellently through several washings, and the they work great to keep my thick hair pulled back while soaking up the water. Would definitely buy again!

I like that they are 100% cotton - NOT microfiber - thank goodness!  Very absorbent - love them!!!  I bought these for my daughters who have hair down to their waist and they love them.  So much easier to use for their hair than a regular bath towel.  They are extra large which helps also.

I have been using Turby Twists since they first came out.  I am down to one of the originals. The microfiber isn't absorbent. Now I saw that this offer was cotton.  They certainly absorb fine and here comes the caveat.  My hair is over 3' long.  This modern version is about 6" shorter so i must fold my hair.  And because of it being shorter it doesn't twist right and putting the tale into the elastic is almost counter productive.

Great head towel! I've used Turbie Twist head towels for several years now and I love them. They absorb well and they are made well. They last a long time. I prefer the cotton ones, I'm not a big fan of micofiber. Mine feel and absorb like a regular towel. I have really long hair so I'm glad these towels are a little longer than previous ones. They all work well but these longer ones are great for long hair.

Okay so not light way like the typical Turbie twists, but I don't care!!! I wanted a towel type material without worry about how I washed it or if I can use softner or not. A towel, like when I would wrap my hair up in a standard towel, that would keep falling which is why I like Turbie Twist. I'm very pleased with the quality and would purchase again!

So happy I ordered there, I've suffered with the thin micro-fiber ones for years..... my daughter has waist length THICK hair, and the micro-fiber Turbie Twists were sopping wet after she used them.... not with these towel ones! I washed them before use, and they got even thicker - they even seem bigger too. Don't hesitate to order - very happy!

Amazing! I will never go back to using a towel again! I have long super thick layered hair. This product holds all of my hair and doesn’t want to slip off. I notice my hair dries quicker too because of the absorbency of this product. I kept the white and great and gifted the other two colors to my daughters. I highly recommend this product.

The only reason I gave this a four star as opposed to five star review is they could be larger. My hair is shoulder length and these are almost too small for my hair length. If you have long hair, these won't do - you'll need to go with a turban that is specifically for long hair.

I LOVE these things!! So much better than trying to wrap a towel around my head. I take them everywhere I go- camping, the cabin, vacations, over night to my bf’s... literally everywhere! That way I always have a towel to wrap around my body and one for my long wet hair :)

I love these things.  I have long hair and it handles the length just fine and is absorbant. They also stay put and do not come off until I remove it. . even when bending over. I really like that they are cotton. I don't care for the micro-fiber ones.

Thick, soft, and completely fits all of my long hair (down past my boobs). I like the colors too. Great quality too. Oh! And each were individually packed in a cute lavender draw string bag. That would be great if you want to give them as gifts!

Much much better then the so called fast drying micro fiber versions. Was looking for the cotton ones in the stores and couldn’t find them. Tried the micro fiber ones and they would just smell after 1 use. Cotton - the fabric of our lives

Much much better then the so called fast drying micro fiber versions. Was looking for the cotton ones in the stores and couldn’t find them. Tried the micro fiber ones and they would just smell after 1 use. Cotton - the fabric of our lives

I much prefer the all cotton turbies to the micro version.  The all-cotton are thick and absorbent and I think will hold their absorbency through more washings than the other version.  I am very happy with them and will order more.

I love that these are thick all cotton, so much more absorbent than other fabrics. They just feel better and stay put better than a towel.  Each of them has a little net carrier for travel too. I do  highly recommend these.

reviews.t: The knock offs aren’t as good so I would say
reviews.x: Been using these for years and I’m hooked! The knock offs aren’t as good so I would say, spend the extra few bucks for the real deal. They also make them in microfiber but in my opinion, those are not as absorbant.

I have hair that holds a ton of water so these are essential for me daily. I do not like the microfiber ones and these were the best deal I could find. I absolutely love them. Great quality, even a year later.

SO hard to find Cotton turbies and not micro-fiber.  Micro-fiber is a quick dry towel, but makes my hair pure static.  These colors are cute, turbies are convenient and LOVE that they are cotton!  Great buy!

reviews.t: Absorbent and best thing since shampoo!
reviews.x: Instead of a huge balancing act with a regular towel,use theses!! They have ones for longer hair,but the regular ones work on mine and I have shoulder length hair. Try it with cotton though,not microfiber.

claims.text: Reviewers strongly prefer the cotton version over microfiber, often praising that these are not microfiber.
The towels are highly absorbent and help hair dry faster than a regular towel.
Many reviewers find them great for long or thick hair, holding all their hair securely.
Some reviewers say the towels are cut smaller than older/original versions, which can be too small for long hair.
Reviewers praise the quality and durability, noting they hold up well through washings.
